source.title: Refine Crystalline Glass - Spell - World of Warcraft

quote: Refine 10 Crystalline Glass to 1 Crystalline Glass.
notes: Patch 12.1 Jewelcrafting refining recipe; Wowhead spell 1307462 states 10 inputs and one output; https://www.wow-professions.com/news/midnight-patch-12-1-knowledge-point-reset explicitly identifies the input as rank 1 and output as rank 2. Item IDs for the rank-specific forms are not established by these text sources; do not equate input and output quality or assume equal price.
where: Midnight Jewelcrafting recipe Refine Crystalline Glass (spell 1307462)
requirements: Midnight Jewelcrafting (50), Jeweler's Tools and Jewelcrafting workbench
